title: Live-site parity manifest
description: Every public URL on the live site, captured before the Next.js migration, with the exact page title. The build must emit a matching static page for each entry.

title.description: Exact <title> tag content on the live site.

source.description: Repo-relative path to the markdown source, for post entries.

external_link.description: If set, this post's canonical content lives at this external URL; the local page still exists and must resolve.
